evidence_location.quote: BTMs related to the induction of interferons as well as the activation of dendritic cells were enriched on days 1 and 3 after TIV vaccination, whereas modules related to T cells at these time points were negatively associated with the antibody response.

hemagglutination-inhibition (HAI) antibo.readouts: influenza antibody titers; fold change in HAI titer; seroconversion/high versus low responder status; day 180 persistence of antibody response

evidence_location.quote: In the 2010 and 2011 seasons, in which elderly subjects were included, antibody responses showed a significant decrease with age.

Flow Cytometry Analysis.readouts: frequencies of total NK cells, NK cell subsets, monocyte subsets; CD69, CCR5, and CD86 staining/activation levels; geometric mean fluorescence intensity (MFI)

evidence_location.quote: Our analysis showed that proportions of total NK cells in elderly subjects were higher than those of young subjects at baseline as well as at all the time points studied (days 0–14).
